references.text: Moses exhorts the people to keep themselves to the Lord's commandments without turning to the right or to the left, using the same language as in Joshua 1:7
The king shall not turn from the law, either to the right or to the left, parallel to the exhortation given to Joshua
Blessing is linked to not turning from the Lord's word to the right or to the left
Moses exhorts Joshua to be strong and courageous, the same encouragement that the Lord gives in Joshua 1:7
Moses says directly to Joshua that he must be strong and courageous, the background for the Lord's words in Joshua 1:7
Repetition of the exhortation to be strong and courageous in the same chapter
Joshua exhorts the people with the same words to keep the law of Moses and not turn from it
Proverbs warns against turning to the right or to the left, the same principle of faithfulness to God's way
The prophecy about hearing a voice that shows the way when one is inclined to turn to the right or to the left
David exhorts Solomon with similar words to be strong and keep the Lord's law in order to prosper
